method.description: One approved read-only shell process loaded the latest QBO_CLIENT_ID, QBO_CLIENT_SECRET, QBO_REFRESH_TOKEN, and QBO_REALM_ID Secret Manager values directly into process-local variables with gcloud stderr suppressed. It submitted an OAuth refresh POST, retained only the HTTP status and in-memory access token, then submitted one Accounting CompanyInfo GET using the in-memory realm and retained only the HTTP status and CompanyName. The process printed or persisted no secret value, realm ID, token, authorization header, request credential, endpoint containing the realm, or provider response payload.

chronology.retentionReason: The one-shot test intentionally retained no provider payload or credential value.

chronology.failureClass: The previously stored deployment-pinned refresh credential was no longer accepted after provider rotation.

currentHealth.reason: The current adapter discards future rotated refresh credentials and defineSecret binding remains deployment-version-pinned. A local code fix is in progress but is not yet reviewed or deployed.

scopeBoundary: The first dated read remains proof that OAuth refresh and CompanyInfo succeeded at that time. Continuing production Accounting health is unresolved until rotating credential persistence is fixed, reviewed, deployed, and followed by a fresh safe read. The reconnect changed only approved secret versions and no Accounting record. This is not Intuit sandbox, entity-write, invoice-send, payment, webhook, refund, or settlement proof.
